instances.name: col_su
instances.note: F20 target 112. SU programme (ot_hbm_su_programme su_prog): linear row L=bank*128+row (bank=L[22:7], row=L[6:0]) via 12-b pages, so the 16-b bank / 7-b row ABI is fully representable on ONE target id; length16 = operand row 0 [15:0]; serial 3:4 domain behind the in-collar rational crossing. Pin-registered: cfg->write 2 edges, launch->start 2 edges (XSER: + crossing 2-3 serial edges, phase-fixed under the common epoch).

instances.name: col_sfu_SW
instances.note: F20 target 116. SFU SW (sfucore_SW): space0 = arithmetic programme {stripe3,addr11}, space1 = IO calendar {stripe2,addr11}; operand row 0 = start base/limit/loops [38:0] and io_start base/limit/loops [77:39]; io_start_v = launch (the IO calendar starts the arithmetic programme itself). Pin-registered: cfg->write 2 edges, launch->start 2 edges (XSER: + crossing 2-3 serial edges, phase-fixed under the common epoch).

instances.name: col_idx
instances.note: F20 target 120. IDX + TOPK + ARGMAX.LOCAL of the SW slice (hb_idx, hb_argmax): space0 = IDX programme (addr8); operand rows 0..5 = length/sectors/rank/gbase/nkeys/keep/die_id + keep_bitmap; record rows = TOPK descriptors (go[0]) and ARGMAX records (go[1]) on compiler offsets. ARGMAX shares this collar (target 121 not used): one launch domain, one SW slice, one fewer tile. Pin-registered: cfg->write 2 edges, launch->start 2 edges (XSER: + crossing 2-3 serial edges, phase-fixed under the common epoch).
